data.name: Isha
data.gender_notes: Isha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ishaq’, meaning ‘night’ or ‘moon’. In the Islamic context, this name is associated with the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) and his wife Asiyah, who was also called Isha. The name Isha carries the meaning “Night, moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Isha usually hope their child will grow to embody night, moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance in Islam, associated with the peaceful and calming presence of the night and the moon.
data.etymology: Isha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night, moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isha total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عشاء
in_arabic.meaning: عشاء تعني اسماء الله الحسنى و اللّيالي و آخر وقت الصلاة
in_arabic.long_meaning: عشاء هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، و يعني اللّيالي و آخر وقت الصلاة، و في القرآن الكريم، عشاء هي إحدى الأوقات التي يذكرها الله في سورة الإسراء، الآية 78، 'وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ طَلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَزُهْرَ النَّهَارِ وَإِذَا انْتَصَفَ النَّهَارُ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ وَمَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَوْقُوتًا'. و في الشّريعة الإسلاميّة، عشاء هي الصّلاة الرّابعة في اليوم و الليلة.

in_urdu.name: عشاء
in_urdu.meaning: عشاء کا مطلب ہے آخر وقت کی نماز اور رات کا وقت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عشاء ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے آخر وقت کی نماز اور رات کا وقت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں ایک خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نماز عشاء کے وقت سے متعلق ہے جو دن کی پانچ نمازوں میں سے ایک ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال دنیا بھر کے مسلمانوں نے کیا ہے خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں جہاں اردو بولی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ईशा
in_hindi.meaning: ईशा का अर्थ है भगवान की प्रार्थना और रात का समय
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईशा एक संस्कृत और अरबी नाम है जो भगवान की प्रार्थना और रात के समय से जुड़ा हुआ है। इस नाम का उपयोग हिंदू और मुस्लिम समुदायों में किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, ईशा का अर्थ है दिन की पांचवीं और अंतिम नमाज जो रात के समय में पढ़ी जाती है।

in_pashto.name: عشاء
in_pashto.meaning: عشاء د څښتن د شپې د وخت او د نماز معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عشاء په پښتو کې د څښتن د شپې د وخت او د نماز معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتنو لخوا کارول کېږي. په اسلامي مذهب کې، عشاء د ورځې پنځمه او وروستۍ نماز ده چې د شپې په وخت کې ادا کیږي.

in_english.name: Isha
in_english.meaning: Isha means God's name, night, and last prayer of the day
in_english.long_meaning: Isha is an Arabic name that means 'God's name,' 'night,' and 'the last prayer of the day.' It originates from the Arabic root 'ع-ش-ء' which conveys the meaning of 'evening' or 'night.' In Islamic tradition, Isha refers to the fifth and final prayer of the day, performed at nightfall. The name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance across various Muslim communities worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Isha' holds cultural significance in the Islamic tradition as it is associated with the fifth daily prayer (Salat Al-Maghrib), which is also referred to as the Isha prayer. This prayer is offered just after sunset, making 'Isha' a common name among Muslim communities, especially for children born during these prayer times.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name 'Isha' is rooted in its connection to the story of Prophet Yusuf and his wife Asiyah in Islam. Asiyah, who was also known as Isha, is regarded as a symbol of patience, devotion, and the power of the human spirit in the face of adversity. Her name serves as an inspiration for Muslims to persevere through life's challenges and to remain steadfast in their faith.
